title: AXI4 Write and Read Address Channels
description: Select an AW or AR signal to see who drives it, which accepting edge samples it, the important encodings, and the failure pattern a verifier should watch for.

signals.name: AWVALID
signals.description: The master asserts AWVALID when AWADDR and every write-address attribute are valid, then holds it until acceptance.
signals.sampled: Rising ACLK edge with AWVALID=1 and AWREADY=1
signals.verificationNote: AWVALID must not depend on AWREADY and cannot drop before the handshake.

signals.name: AWREADY
signals.description: The slave asserts AWREADY when it can accept the write address and its attributes.
signals.sampled: Rising ACLK edge with AWVALID=1 and AWREADY=1
signals.verificationNote: AWREADY may wait for AWVALID, but the implementation must avoid circular channel dependencies.

signals.name: AWADDR
signals.description: The master supplies the start byte address for the write burst.
values: Must support the configured address width
signals.verificationNote: Check stability under backpressure and the 4 KB boundary rule for the complete burst.

signals.name: AWID
signals.description: AWID identifies the write transaction's ordering stream and is returned as BID with the write response.
signals.verificationNote: Correlate BID to the accepted AWID; different IDs permit response reordering but do not waive same-ID ordering.

signals.name: AWLEN
signals.description: AWLEN encodes the number of W beats minus one. In AXI4, INCR can use 1–256 beats; other burst types remain limited to 16.
signals.verificationNote: Require WLAST on exactly beat AWLEN+1 and reject unsupported burst-length/type combinations.

signals.name: AWSIZE
signals.description: AWSIZE is the base-2 logarithm of bytes transferred per beat and cannot exceed the interface data width.
signals.typicalUse: Determine byte lanes and address increment
signals.verificationNote: Cross-check AWSIZE with AWADDR alignment, WSTRB, bus width, and burst address generation.

signals.name: AWBURST
signals.description: AWBURST selects FIXED, INCR, or WRAP address progression for the W beats.
signals.verificationNote: Flag the reserved encoding, illegal WRAP lengths/alignment, and any burst crossing 4 KB.

signals.name: ARVALID
signals.description: The master asserts ARVALID when ARADDR and every read-address attribute are valid, then holds it until acceptance.
signals.sampled: Rising ACLK edge with ARVALID=1 and ARREADY=1
signals.verificationNote: ARVALID must not depend on ARREADY and cannot drop before the handshake.

signals.name: ARREADY
signals.description: The slave asserts ARREADY when it can accept the read address and its attributes.
signals.sampled: Rising ACLK edge with ARVALID=1 and ARREADY=1
signals.verificationNote: Do not create a combinational dependency that can deadlock another channel.

signals.name: ARADDR
signals.description: The master supplies the start byte address for the read burst.
values: Must support the configured address width
signals.verificationNote: Check stability under backpressure and the 4 KB boundary rule for the complete burst.

signals.name: ARID
signals.description: ARID identifies the read transaction's ordering stream and is returned on every R beat as RID.
signals.verificationNote: Every RID beat must map to an outstanding ARID and maintain per-ID beat and transaction order.

signals.name: ARLEN
signals.description: ARLEN encodes the number of R beats minus one. In AXI4, INCR can use 1–256 beats; other burst types remain limited to 16.
signals.verificationNote: Require RLAST on exactly beat ARLEN+1, even when one or more beats report an error.

signals.name: ARSIZE
signals.description: ARSIZE is the base-2 logarithm of bytes transferred per beat and cannot exceed the interface data width.
signals.typicalUse: Determine valid read byte lanes and address increment
signals.verificationNote: Cross-check ARSIZE with ARADDR alignment, bus width, and the byte lanes the master consumes.

signals.name: ARBURST
signals.description: ARBURST selects FIXED, INCR, or WRAP address progression for the R beats.
signals.verificationNote: Flag the reserved encoding, illegal WRAP lengths/alignment, and any burst crossing 4 KB.
